description_en: Queries the online time distribution of a specified terminal device on a specified date, aggregated by minute
description_zh: 查询指定终端设备在指定日期内按分钟统计的在线时段分布
name: GetDeviceOnlineHeatmap

parameters.help_en:
The user ID. You can obtain this value from the following operations:
[ListUserDevices](~~ListUserDevices~~): Lists user terminal devices.
[GetUserDevice](~~GetUserDevice~~): Queries the details of a user terminal device
parameters.help_zh:
用户ID。取值来源：
[ListUserDevices](~~ListUserDevices~~)：批量查询用户终端设备。
[GetUserDevice](~~GetUserDevice~~)：查询用户终端设备详情
parameters.name: sase_user_id

parameters.help_en: The date to query, in the format yyyyMMdd with a fixed length of 8 characters. Online data is retained for only 8 days. Dates beyond the retention period return an empty list
parameters.help_zh: 待查询的日期，格式为yyyyMMdd，长度固定为8个字符。在线数据仅保留8天，超出保留期的日期将返回空列表
parameters.name: date
